title: MixSceneDocument
description: A libsonare mixer scene: the document `sonare mix --scene` reads, `suggestMixScene` returns, and `Mixer.fromSceneJson` builds a graph from. Field paths are held to src/mixing/api/scene_json.cpp's scene_schema_paths() by tests/conformance/check_result_schema_surfaces.py, so this file cannot drift from the writer. Two things this schema deliberately does not describe. The parser also accepts a legacy snake_case spelling of most keys (fader_db beside faderDb); the writer never emits one, and admitting them here would let a document validate in a shape nothing produces. And a scene reaches the mixer through the C++ parser, which refuses values this schema cannot express - an unknown insert processor, a send naming a bus that is not in the document, a connection whose endpoints do not exist. Validating here narrows what reaches that parser; it does not replace it.

version.description: Scene document version. 1 is the only accepted value; the parser refuses anything else rather than attempting a migration.

strips.description: Channel strips. A strip is fed by one source and is named by its id, which is what a send's destinationBusId, a connection's source, and a vcaGroup's members refer to.

buses.description: Summing buses. Exactly one bus conventionally carries role 'master'; every other bus reaches it through a connection.

vcaGroups.description: VCA groups. A group applies its gain to every member strip's vcaOffsetDb without moving the strips' own faders.

connections.description: Routing edges. Each names a source strip or bus and the bus it sums into; a strip reaches the output only through one.

slot.description: Where the insert runs relative to the fader. Defaults to 'pre'.

processor.description: Processor id, e.g. 'dynamics.compressor' or 'effects.reverb.plate'. The accepted set is the `processors[].id` list in the capability catalog (schemas/capability-catalog.schema.json); an id outside it is refused by the parser, not by this schema.

params.description: The processor's parameters, as an object keyed by parameter name ({"ratio": 4}). Each processor's parameter names, ranges and defaults are the catalog's `processors[].params[]`; a name outside that set is ignored by the processor and reported on the load warning channel, not refused here. Values are numbers or booleans, with two narrow exceptions the processor that owns the key reads itself: a string for a named rig or an embedded impulse response, and a per-band array for the acoustic room morph.

sidechainKey.description: Names the signal this insert keys off, for the processors that take one. Empty means no sidechain.

id.description: Send id, unique within the strip.

destinationBusId.description: The id of the bus this send feeds. It must name a bus present in this document.

timing.description: Whether the send is taken before or after the strip's fader. A post-fader send follows the fader; a pre-fader one does not.

surroundPan.description: Surround position. Omitted entirely by the writer at the centred point-source default, so a stereo scene carries no surroundPan object at all.

metering.description: Which meters this strip computes. Switching one off costs nothing but the measurement.

truePeakOversample.description: Oversampling factor for the inter-sample peak meter.

id.description: Strip id, unique within the document. A `mix --input ID=file.wav` entry feeds the strip of this name.

inputTrimDb.description: Gain applied before the strip's inserts, used to stage a source to a working level.

faderDb.description: The strip's fader, applied after its pre-fader inserts.

vcaOffsetDb.description: Offset contributed by the vcaGroups this strip belongs to. Written by the mixer; setting it by hand is additive with the group's own gain.

pan.description: Stereo position, -1 hard left to +1 hard right.

width.description: Stereo width: 0 is mono, 1 is unchanged, 2 is doubled. The mixer clamps to [0, 2] on construction, so a scene it emitted is always inside this range and a value outside it would be silently narrowed rather than honoured. Requires a stereo source.

soloSafe.description: Keeps this strip audible while another is soloed - what a reverb return wants, so soloing a source does not also mute its tail.

panMode.description: Panner shape, matching SONARE_PAN_MODE_*. 0 is balance, which is what `pan` drives; a dual-pan mode reads dualPanLeft / dualPanRight instead.

dualPanLeft.description: Destination of the source's left channel under a dual-pan panMode. Ignored in balance mode.

dualPanRight.description: Destination of the source's right channel under a dual-pan panMode. Ignored in balance mode.

panLaw.description: Pan law, matching the PanLaw enum order. 0 is Const3dB.

channelDelaySamples.description: Whole-sample delay applied to this strip, for time-aligning a multi-mic source against its siblings.

sourceLayout.description: Channel layout of the source feeding this strip. Written only when it is not the stereo default.

inserts.description: Processors on this strip, run in array order within each slot.

sends.description: Feeds from this strip to buses, each with its own level and timing.

id.description: Bus id, unique within the document and referred to by sends and connections.

role.description: What the bus is for. 'master' marks the output bus and carries the project output layout; 'aux' is an effect return and 'group' a subgroup. The parser does not restrict this string, so a role it does not recognise is stored rather than refused - which means a misspelt 'master' produces a scene with no output bus instead of an error.

layout.description: Channel layout of this bus. The master bus carries the project output layout.

width.description: Stereo width of the bus, clamped to [0, 2] the way a strip's is.

inserts.description: Processors on this bus, run on the summed signal.

gainDb.description: Gain the group contributes to every member's vcaOffsetDb.

members.description: Ids of the strips this group drives.

source.description: Id of the strip or bus this edge takes signal from.

destination.description: Id of the bus this edge sums into.
